events.description: Police officer draws and aims a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle is visible and pointed forward in a clear shooting posture.
A police officer draws and aims a handgun directly at the camera; the muzzle is visible and pointed forward, consistent with an imminent or ongoing discharge.
A police officer leans into a car and forcibly takes a teddy bear from a seated child, who appears distressed and helpless; the action constitutes physical coercion against a vulnerable individual.
A uniformed officer physically assaults a seated woman in the back of a car, grabbing her and striking or shoving her repeatedly; she is visibly distressed and unable to effectively resist.
The woman appears to push back or struggle against the officer during the assault, indicating mutual physical engagement, though she remains largely overpowered.

After the initial assault, the woman is shown slumped and injured (blood visible on her shirt), while the officer reacts with apparent shock or regret, suggesting continued vulnerability and lack of autonomy for the victim.

A police officer is seen physically assaulting a young girl inside a car; the officer leans into the vehicle and appears to strike or forcefully grab her, while she reacts with visible distress and pain.

The interaction between the officer and the girl involves mutual physical struggle: the girl resists (e.g., raising arms, recoiling), while the officer exerts force, indicating active combat rather than one-sided assault alone.
A motorcyclist in a suit and helmet grabs a running schoolgirl from behind, pulling her toward the motorcycle; she is visibly distressed and resisting.
The motorcyclist lifts the girl onto the back of the moving motorcycle against her will; she is clinging to her stuffed animal and screaming, with legs dangling and no control over her position.

The girl is now seated precariously on the rear of the motorcycle, still smiling/laughing but clearly in distress (blood on lip, strained expression), while the rider maintains control; this continues the non-consensual transport.

A person in a suit is riding a motorcycle with a second person (wearing a school uniform and red shoes) clinging to the back, legs dangling and body slumped, appearing helpless and distressed; the rider maintains control while the passenger is visibly struggling and smiling/ grimacing in apparent distress or fear.

A white van is shown at an intersection with its side door open and driver partially outside; the van is tilted sharply on two wheels (left wheels lifted), indicating loss of control or collision impact during a turn or maneuver.

A man in a white shirt (inside a moving van) and a motorcyclist engage in a physical struggle at the open side door of the van; the motorcyclist reaches in, they grapple, and the man pulls a woman out of the van while the motorcyclist assists or resists, culminating in a chaotic tangle of bodies.

A person in a helmet (motorcyclist) is engaged in a physical struggle with a woman being pulled from a vehicle; they grapple, with the woman resisting and the motorcyclist attempting to restrain or extract her.

The woman appears to be in a vulnerable position—partially outside a moving vehicle—and is being forcibly handled by the helmeted individual, suggesting she is a helpless victim of non-consensual physical coercion.
